text: Staff from the City Solicitor's Office are attending to inform and seek instructions, from the Board, in relation to certain issues that have arisen with regards to this matter.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Confirmed its actions in closed session in issuing instructions to staff. 2. Directed that the information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (September 19, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains advice which is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.
